structure_review.notes: There is a single inference R001 directly producing P; all listed propositions lie in its direct-input set, so the visible graph is structurally closed at this level, but the argument does not establish the target. In particular local declaration A_i (type projection of V_i to ℝⁿ) says instead 'Define ν=volume.restrict([0,1])', which declares no A_i and does not define ν's asserted type. More substantively, R001's lower-bound route constructs covers and interval enclosures and invokes a purported product-measure/cover-cost estimate without a proved derivation; the listed M sources do not establish that estimate. M002, for example, only exchanges a countable tsum with a lintegral under AEMeasurability, which does not itself prove the geometric lower bound. Witness U_{j,i} also claims an arbitrary countable cover with small cost from zero Hausdorff measure and compactness without supplying the required cover construction/replacement details. Thus AND closure cannot be granted for R001/P. No packet replay was performed or fabricated.
